description: This file defines the LatestVersionSelector class, which implements the IVersionSelector interface to select the latest compatible version from a list of available versions based on compatibility checks.

classes.name: LatestVersionSelector
classes.description: A class responsible for selecting the highest compatible version from a list of available versions.

methods.name: GetSuitableVersion
methods.description: Returns the highest compatible version from the available versions based on the requested version and compatibility checks.
